description: This file contains the implementation of SQL store methods for managing blocks in a Mattermost Focalboard server, including CRUD operations, history management, and hierarchical retrieval of blocks.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer for blocks, providing methods for CRUD operations, history, and hierarchy management.

methods.name: timestampToCharField
methods.description: Converts a timestamp field to a string representation based on the database type.

methods.name: blockFields
methods.description: Returns a list of SQL fields for retrieving block data, optionally with a table alias.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves blocks based on query options such as BoardID, ParentID, BlockType, pagination.

methods.name: getBlocksWithParentAndType
methods.description: Retrieves blocks with specific parent and type filters.

methods.name: getBlocksWithParent
methods.description: Retrieves blocks with specific parent ID.

methods.name: getBlocksByIDs
methods.description: Fetches blocks by a list of IDs.

methods.name: getBlocksWithType
methods.description: Retrieves blocks of a specific type within a board.

methods.name: getSubTree2
methods.description: Returns blocks within 2 levels of a given block ID, with optional time filtering and limit.

methods.name: getBlocksForBoard
methods.description: Retrieves all blocks for a specific board.

methods.name: blocksFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of Block objects.

methods.name: insertBlock
methods.description: Inserts or updates a block in the database, also maintaining history.

methods.name: patchBlock
methods.description: Applies a patch to an existing block.

methods.name: patchBlocks
methods.description: Applies multiple patches to blocks.

methods.name: insertBlocks
methods.description: Inserts multiple blocks into the database.

methods.name: deleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a block and its children, with history recording.

methods.name: retrieveFileIDFromBlockFieldStorage
methods.description: Extracts file ID from block field string.

methods.name: deleteBlockAndChildren
methods.description: Deletes a block and optionally its children, recording history and handling file info.

methods.name: undeleteBlock
methods.description: Restores a deleted block from history.

methods.name: getBlockCountsByType
methods.description: Returns a count of blocks grouped by type.

methods.name: getBoardCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of boards.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Fetches a block by ID.

methods.name: getBlockHistory
methods.description: Retrieves historical versions of a block.

methods.name: getBlockHistoryDescendants
methods.description: Retrieves historical descendant blocks for a board.

methods.name: getBlockHistoryNewestChildren
methods.description: Gets latest version child blocks for a parent, including deleted.

methods.name: getBoardAndCardByID
methods.description: Returns the board and card parent for a block ID.

methods.name: getBoardAndCard
methods.description: Returns the board and card for a block.

methods.name: replaceBlockID
methods.description: Replaces block IDs and related references across the database.

methods.name: duplicateBlock
methods.description: Duplicates a block subtree, optionally as a template.

methods.name: deleteBlockChildren
methods.description: Deletes child blocks of a parent, recording history.

methods.name: undeleteBlockChildren
methods.description: Restores child blocks from history.
